jobs.description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.

The role

You will own how new GPU servers become ready for customers: from racks at a datacenter to tested, production-ready nodes. You will define when a node is ready, build the automation that gets it there, and keep the fleet healthy once it is running.

This is a hands-on senior role on a small team. You will work with datacenter partners and their on-site staff, and closely with the engineers who own routing and the network.

The work

We bring up large GPU servers at datacenters we don't own. Each node has to be provisioned, tested hard and proven healthy before customers use it. Between customers it has to be wiped clean. Once in service, failing hardware has to be caught early and taken out of rotation. The hard part is doing this the same way, every time, across many sites, with a small team.

What you bring

  • You have brought up multi-GPU servers or clusters for production workloads, including acceptance testing and burn-in.

  • Experience with high-speed GPU networking such as InfiniBand or RoCE.

  • You have automated bare-metal provisioning and kept firmware and images consistent across a fleet.

  • You can diagnose GPU and server hardware faults and decide when to repair or replace.

  • You have run GPUs inside virtual machines or otherwise isolated customers on shared hardware.

  • You have worked with remote datacenter staff and been on call for a fleet.

  • You write scripts and tools in a language such as Python, Go or Bash.

  • You use AI tools well and check their work.

You do not need ML model experience. What matters is that you have put real GPU hardware into service for other people's workloads and kept it running.

About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. Customers bring their own models, and we run them as fast, reliable production endpoints on GPU servers across many sites. We are a small team of about five engineers.

The role

You will own the network that customer traffic enters through and the links that connect our sites. You will design it, build it and run it in production.

This is a hands-on senior role on a small team. You will work closely with the engineer who owns request routing, and with the people bringing new GPU sites online.

The work

Customers reach us through a set of points of presence on the public internet. Behind them, our GPU sites stay private and connect out to us. You will run that edge: the addresses customers connect to, the protection that keeps attacks away from our servers, and the private links back to each site. The hard part is doing this with a small team, so it has to be automated, observable and calm under attack.

What you bring

  • You have designed and run production networks across multiple locations.

  • Strong fundamentals in BGP, DNS, TCP and TLS, and load balancing.

  • You have handled DDoS attacks or built the protection against them.

  • You manage network configuration as code, not by hand.

  • You have been on call for a network and led incident response.

  • You can write tools and automation in a language such as Go, Rust or Python.

  • You write clearly.

  • You use AI tools well and check their work.

You do not need GPU or ML experience. What matters is that you have run networks people depend on and want to build one from the start.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - ADMS
jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewPower your Future with Qualus in our Digital Solutions department as a Senior Power Systems Engineer.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Power your Future with Qualus in our Digital Solutions department as a Senior Power Systems Engineer. As a Senior Power Systems Engineer you will play a pivotal role in large scale system integration programs and take on the delivery of ADMS/OMS system and integration implementations from our leading ADMS/OMS software partners. You will also be providing consulting and project management services to our existing customers on projects involving product installation, integration development, interface support, modeling, application tuning, and system maintenance.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate all technical aspects of the project including planning, design, development, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop and execute system build plans accounting for software architecture, information security, and hardware deployment.
  • Work with the Project Manager and provide technical input into the overall project schedule, budget, resource requirements, and risk management.
  • Lead engineering workshops on topics such as system design, data conversion, business process reviews, test, and validation planning, and change management.
  • Installation and configuration of OSI monarch advanced distribution management applications
  • Design and configure SCADA/GMS/EMS/ADMS/OMS systems to meet the specific needs of our clients.
  • Deploy and integrate SCADA/GMS/EMS/ADMS/OMS systems with other equipment and software.
  • Provide training and support to clients during and after the implementation process.
  • Collaborate with project teams and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation of the project.
  • Perform system and acceptance testing with the end customers.
  • Test and validate system configurations to ensure they meet client requirements and industry standards including NERC CIP.
  • Develop scripts and other solutions to integrate 3rd party systems.
  • Identify and troubleshoot any issues that arise during the implementation process.
  • Keep up to date with the latest developments in the field and ensure systems are implemented in accordance with industry best practices.
  • Travel to customer sites and work directly with customers to successfully deliver, test, and integrate systems
  • Contribute to proposals, work plans, budgets, and schedules for services opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field of study.
  • Ten (10) years of combined experience in project management and utility systems software implementation and consulting.
  • Demonstratable experience interacting with clients to understand relationships and priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual skills.
  • Ability to operate as part of a team in organizing, leading, planning, and executing large-scale projects from the envisioning stage through implementation.
  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on client business goals.
  • Knowledge of project integration lifecycle and methodology.
  • Excellent problem-solving, written and oral communications and customer service skills.
  • Ability to lead and facilitate workshops covering the full breadth of the project lifecycle.
  • Ability to work with new technologies and tools as required by the needs of a project. (MS Project, JIRA, OneNote)
  • Ability to work independently and self-direct your workday.
  • Experience creating work estimates, staffing plans, and proposals for projects of various scale and complexity.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 50% to customer project sites
  • Experience and ability to work on projects that may not be ADMS /OMS related with appropriate training.
  • Installation and configuration of OSI monarch advanced distribution management applications such as Distribution Power Flow (DPF), Fault Location Isolation & Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt/VAR Control & Optimization (VVC/VVO)
  • Experience with GIS building tools and model
  • Experience in configuring Maven, Leitmotif, and eMAP

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.
